# Review screenshots

These are the 1440 px screenshots from the real-backend review runs of the `apps/web` UI, one folder per build stage (`stage-a` to `stage-e`; see [`docs/web-app-plan.md`](../web-app-plan.md) section 10 for what each stage built).

**Only the 1440 px images are committed.** The same scripts also save 900 px and 390 px versions (`*-900.png`, `*-390.png`); those are **regenerated by the script and are not committed** (`.gitignore` in this folder keeps them out). The 900 px and 390 px checks themselves still run every time: each script asserts there is no horizontal overflow at all three widths.

To regenerate every width, start the console and the web app on a fresh seeded throwaway database and run the review scripts as described in [`apps/web/README.md`](../../apps/web/README.md#scripts), for example:

```bash
node apps/web/scripts/review-screenshots-b.mjs docs/screenshots/stage-b
```

The images show fictional data only (Alice, Bob and Carol, `example.test` addresses, and a throwaway key generated by the seed script). They are same-author evidence from one browser (Chrome): they show what the interface looked like in that run, not that it has been independently reviewed.
